policy_follow_up.author: RonnyPfannschmidt
policy_follow_up.pr85_reason: Not established by the returned discussion; do not infer its closure reason.
policy_follow_up.interpretation: The initial repository-file policy scan was incomplete. An actual maintainer AI-rejection is relevant to this workflow, but the short comment does not define every permitted or prohibited use. Park autonomous AI-authored publication until current contributor expectations are established; the maintainer's own AI use is not blanket permission.
policy_follow_up.root_verification: Coordinator independently read the full issue83, exact source _parse.py and __init__.py, complete source-tree paths, PR84 and85 canonical states, and all returned PR84 issue comments.

remaining_technical_lead.scope: Three documentation statements incorrectly say strip_section_whitespace changes section and key names. Code applies the option only to sections and always strips keys. No corresponding documentation correction was found in the inspected PR84/85 diffs and one targeted search.
remaining_technical_lead.limits: Static source comparison only. No reproduction, implementation, fork creation, upstream comment, PR or validation was performed. Header error-vs-warning compatibility remains a distinct maintainer decision.

next_run_correction: Coordinator assigns at most three explicit candidate IDs before delegation. The cap is global across all delegates; blocked or duplicate discoveries consume a slot. Check actual relevant PR disposition and policy-enforcement comments before selecting a source-writing task. No replacement candidate after all slots are consumed.
